description: zkSync Era rollup batches from the public block explorer API: the newest N batches (1 to 20) with batch number, time, status (sealed, committed, proven, executed), L1 and L2 transaction counts, and the chain ids where each step was posted. Hyperchain (other zkSync chains) data is not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
